findings.note: Glossary drift for "image": all 20 strings use इमेज, a spelling that appears nowhere else in the 58 hi catalogues, while the existing hi UI renders image as तस्वीर (ui.canvas.files.images/expand/imageActions, ui.library.category.images, and ui.projects.project_quick_send "paste an image to attach it" → "तस्वीर जोड़ने के लिए पेस्ट करें") and चित्र only in four settings descriptions; adopting तस्वीर also gives in_message/limit a real plural (तस्वीरें) where इमेज is invariant. The proposals here keep every other wording unchanged; a locale-wide switch to इमेज instead would be a style-guide decision, not a per-PR one. The proposed values in this finding are the fully remediated text (they also fold in the position/retry/candrabindu/nukta/remove_all/error_quota fixes below); the other findings' proposals are written against the current इमेज so each stands alone.

These are screen-reader-only names (img alt, li/button aria-label, the lightbox's sr-only DialogTitle) and composed into remove/retry, and Hindi TTS reads "1/2" as a fraction (एक बटा दो / आधा) rather than "1 of 2"; the established hi pattern for "X {index} of {count}" is "कुल {count} में से X {index}" (ui.common.forms.pagination.position, ui.installer.status.step, ui.library.preview.slide_of).

validation.semantics: Each string judged in its real UI role: composer icon-button aria-label/title (add, and limit as its disabled title), thumbnail-strip ul aria-label (strip), positional alt/aria/lightbox sr-only DialogTitle (position), message image-group aria-label (in_message), thumbnail button aria/title (open), 5×5 icon-button aria/title on composer chips (remove, retry — retry renders only when the bytes are still held), Spinner label and chip aria suffix (uploading), the strip notice line (limit, unsupported, failure copy, expired_staged), message placeholders in a 36×24 tile (expired, unavailable) with a text-link retry (retry_load), the composer alert under page and thread composers (send_blocked), and a whitespace-nowrap ghost Button in the reschedule dialog (remove_all). Meaning is preserved everywhere, including unsupported's trimmed English, error_offline's causal order (Local Operator unreachable → upload failed → retry when back), expired_staged's conditional retry, and limit's per-message cap. Register is आप-polite imperatives throughout; संगठन, संदेश, अपलोड, ज़्यादा, इस्तेमाल, फ़ाइल match existing hi usage; Local Operator and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF stay Latin per the product-name policy. Findings: image term drift (MINOR), "1/2" as a spoken position (MINOR), retry verb drift plus the "या फिर" misparse (MINOR), -ाएं vs the style guide's -ाएँ (MINOR), खराब nukta (NIT), remove_all lost plural (NIT), error_quota lost "you" (NIT). The other 13 keys' wording is clean apart from the term in finding 1.
validation.icu: Parsed en and hi for all 23 keys with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser from the repo's node_modules: argument sets identical in every key — {index}/{count} in position and open, {label} in remove and retry, {count, plural, one|other} with # in in_message, {max, plural, one|other} with # in limit; no select, number skeleton or markup. hi CLDR plural categories are one/other with 0 and 1 → one (Intl.PluralRules('hi') checked), so no extra branch is needed; # is used in both branches of both plurals. Formatted with intl-messageformat (locale hi) at 0/1/2/10: limit switches है/हैं correctly; in_message's branches are identical ("# इमेज") because इमेज is invariant, which is grammatical but is part of finding 1. All 23 proposals in this receipt also parse with the same argument sets.
validation.typography: All 23 values are NFC; no U+200B–F, U+202A–E, U+2066–9, U+061C, ZWJ or ZWNJ; no value equals English; Latin digits only (none hand-written); danda । ends every sentence that ends with a period in English; the ellipsis in uploading is U+2026; Latin runs are only Local Operator and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF; the file ends with a newline.
